title: Versioned synthetic instruction probe and scorer contract

data_protocol.test_set_rule: Do not use test metrics for task selection, training, checkpoint selection, or tuning. This task contamination audit may scan test text by the frozen hashes/ngram rule. Reserve model test metrics for one final, preregistered evaluation after the sequence-campaign systems and analysis are frozen.

task_set.source: Original in-repository toy lookup and ordering examples; no external benchmark or corpus examples.
task_set.scope: Deterministic instruction-following/scorer smoke probe only; it is not a broad capability benchmark and is not a substitute for held-out language-model metrics.

primary_task_metric.name: exact_match
primary_task_metric.rule: Greedy prediction and target are compared after stripping leading/trailing Unicode whitespace; comparison is case-sensitive and punctuation-sensitive. No other normalization is applied.

secondary_task_metric.name: conditional_bits_per_utf8_byte
secondary_task_metric.rule: Teacher-forced target NLL includes EOS. Divide summed natural-log NLL by ln(2) and by the target UTF-8 byte count; BOS is not scored and EOS has zero byte coverage.

scoring.target_construction: Encode prompt with BOS and without EOS; encode target without BOS and with EOS. Score every target token exactly once.
scoring.generation: Greedy decoding; at most eight new tokens; stop at EOS.

hand_checked_examples.reasoning: The table maps azure to qom.
Moving the final label tul to the front yields [tul, bim, kav].
The N8 row maps to gok.
Key M is paired with value 6.

contamination_check.scope: Scan each task prompt, target and concatenated prompt-target against all 21 normalized Q10 train/validation/test documents. The scan is mechanical and does not calculate model scores or use test text for task selection.
contamination_check.exact_identity: Unicode NFC plus collapsed Unicode whitespace, matching the Q10 document identity policy.
contamination_check.phrase_overlap: Casefold each whitespace-delimited token and require zero shared contiguous 13-token sequences between task strings and any Q10 document.
contamination_check.record: Per-task exact-identity and shared-13-gram counts plus source/split hashes; do not store matched source text.
contamination_check.acceptance: Zero exact identity matches and zero shared 13-token sequences in train, validation and test.
contamination_check.limitations: This detects full-example identity and long exact phrase reuse, not semantic similarity or shorter/common phrase reuse.

control: The hand-computed toy mappings and scorer truth table above; existing jsonl-prompt-target-v1 behavior is the compatibility reference. This is an evaluator-validation control, not a capability comparison.
evaluation_metrics: task artifact SHA-256 and stable example IDs
hand-checked target answers and exact-match semantics
per-example target token and UTF-8 byte counts
conditional bits per UTF-8 byte with EOS zero-byte coverage
exact identity and shared 13-token overlap counts by Q10 split
validation bits per UTF-8 byte for conventional baselines
hypothesis: The four original toy examples have hand-verifiable targets, the scorer records exact-match and byte-normalized conditional likelihood per example, and no task string has exact identity or long-phrase overlap with Q10 train/validation/test content.
change: Freeze a versioned task JSONL, exact-match and byte-normalized NLL contracts, hand-check table, and content-overlap audit before evaluator changes or baseline training.
result: Pending. Scorer validation and the contamination scan have not been run.
interpretation: Pending. The toy task set is a scorer smoke probe and cannot support a broad capability claim.
next_experiment: Implement scorer byte normalization and deterministic task-contamination audit; then preregister a bounded three-seed conventional GQA baseline using Q10 data and tokenizer before training.
